public_home.hero_section: Hero banner featuring a subtle dark sovereign navy mesh gradient with Astana skyline watermark, high-impact headline with gold accent kicker, 2-column key metric stat counter (Total Tender Volume, Active Bidders, Compliance Rate), and direct action buttons for 'Explore Live Tenders' and 'Portal Gateways'.
public_home.credibility_strip: Trust bar displaying verified certifications (EBRD compliant, Samruk-Kazyna gateway, CIS ISO-9001 certified) and enterprise counters.
public_home.live_tenders_teaser: Bento-style 3-card preview of highest-value active procurement notices with countdown timer, sector pill tag, and immediate action link.
public_home.sector_coverage: Grid of 6 major procurement verticals: Energy & Resources, Infrastructure & Civil, Health & Pharma, Defense & Security, IT & Telecom, Agricultural Logistics.

five_portal_login.concept: A 5-card role selector replacing the outdated 2-card tab. Each role is represented as an enterprise credential badge.

portals.title: System Administrator
portals.description: System configuration, user provisioning, master catalogs, and platform audit logs.

portals.title: PMC Management
portals.description: Executive oversight, tender awards, committee evaluations, and financial escrow analytics.

portals.title: Strategic Partners
portals.description: Bank guarantee verifications, regulatory auditing, and co-procurement dashboards.

portals.title: Procurement Agents
portals.description: Tender drafting, bidder dossier review, Corrigenda releases, and BOQ verification.

portals.title: Registered Vendors
portals.description: Tender purchasing, digital bid submission, live reverse auctions, and contract signatures.

public_tender_listings.filters: Search bar with multi-select dropdowns for Category/Sector, Status (Live, Under Evaluation, Awarded), Minimum/Maximum Estimate (KZT/USD), and Closing Date picker.
public_tender_listings.card_design: Clean border-encased cards with bold tender reference number, status indicator light (pulsing green for Live, amber for Extended, neutral for Closed), region/location badge, EMD requirements, and 'View Tender Specification' button.

footer.layout: 4-column dark sovereign navy footer (#0B132B) with gold line separator.

required_social_icons.aria_label: Official PMC Managers WhatsApp support channel

admin_console_shell.pattern: Retain 5-section collapsible left sidebar + top hamburger drawer for mobile viewports.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based test IDs on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='portal-card-admin', data-testid='tender-filter-search-input', data-testid='footer-social-whatsapp')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rules: All text must maintain 4.5:1 contrast minimum against dark navy (#0B132B) or light canvas (#F8FAFC). Gold accents on text must use deep gold (#B89628 or #D4AF37 with text-shadow) for high readability.
testing_and_accessibility.hover_states: All buttons and portal cards must specify explicit text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-slate-950).

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply this design system consistently across all public components under /app/frontend/src/apps/notice-board/ and shared components.
Update /app/frontend/src/apps/shared/UnifiedLogin.jsx to present the 5 dedicated portal login cards (Admin, Management, Partners, Agents, Vendors).
Update /app/frontend/src/components/PmcFooter.jsx to render Snapchat, Instagram, and WhatsApp social icons with proper attributes and tooltips.
Maintain high typography contrast with Libre Baskerville headings and IBM Plex Sans body text.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
